svg.title: BME280 wiring to a Raspberry Pi 40-pin header
svg.desc: The BME280 breakout connects to the Raspberry Pi over I2C with four leads: VIN to pin 1 (3V3), GND to pin 6 (GND), SCL to pin 5 (GPIO3 / SCL1) and SDA to pin 3 (GPIO2 / SDA1).
svg.text: Four leads over I²C. rskycam reads the sensor on /dev/i2c-1.
the six pins nearest the USB-C end
pin 1 — square pad on the board
6-pin GY-BME280 boards: leave CSB and SDO unconnected.
Wiring is the same on every 40-pin Raspberry Pi. rskycam probes both 0x76 and 0x77, so either address strap works.
